subject: Inclusionary Housing Zoning Ordinance
overview: The Medford City Council held a public hearing and adopted an inclusionary housing zoning ordinance on first reading to require affordable units in major developments. The Council also heard updates regarding the transition of Lawrence Memorial Hospital, tabled an MBTA temporary bus stop proposal to allow for resident notification, and addressed various municipal resolutions.

items.title: Updates and Petition on Lawrence Memorial Hospital
items.summary: Heard updates from Lawrence Memorial Hospital representatives regarding emergency room closure plans and the proposed ambulatory surgery center, and voted to reconvene in one month while referring neighborhood concerns to a committee meeting.

items.title: Common Victualler License for Five Guys
items.summary: Tabled the common victualler license application for Five Guys Burgers and Fries because the petitioner was not present.

items.title: West Medford Baptist Church Sign Permit Denial Appeal
items.summary: Referred an appeal for an oversized illuminated programmable sign at West Medford Baptist Church to the Business, Economic Development and Signs Subcommittee.

items.title: Public Hearing on Inclusionary Housing Ordinance
items.summary: Approved on first reading a proposed zoning amendment establishing an inclusionary housing special permit process with affordable housing thresholds, incorporating Community Development Board recommendations.

items.title: Parking Sign Relocation and Route 16 Truck Parking
items.summary: Approved resolutions requesting the DPW to relocate a 30-minute parking sign in West Medford Square and requesting DCR to prohibit overnight truck parking on the Route 16 bypass.

items.title: Condolences and Moment of Silence
items.summary: Extended condolences to the family of Thomas Kreatz and observed a moment of silence for longtime resident Josephine Gilberto.

items.title: MBTA Route 80 Temporary Bus Stops Petition
items.summary: Tabled for two weeks an MBTA request to install four temporary bus stops during Green Line Extension bridge construction in order to notify affected residents.

items.title: Community Preservation Committee Annual Report
items.summary: Received and placed on file the Community Preservation Committee's 2018 annual review and overview of the 2019 grant application process.

items.title: Tree Removal Permitting Resolution
items.summary: Withdrew a resolution requesting the City Solicitor to draft an ordinance governing tree removal and replacement on private property following council debate.

items.title: Special Permit Conditions Legal Opinion Request
items.summary: Approved a request for a legal opinion from the City Solicitor on whether council rules can automatically attach applicant-specific conditions to special permits.

items.title: Donation Box Cleanup and Seasonal Items
items.summary: Approved resolutions requesting cleanup of overfilled donation boxes on Mystic Avenue and Fells Plaza, and the removal of plaza chairs and holiday lights at City Hall.

items.title: Council Chamber Audio System
items.summary: Approved a resolution to address audio system feedback issues in the City Council chambers.

items.title: Committee Reports and Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Adopted committee reports regarding polling locations and youth affairs, and approved the meeting minutes of February 5, 2019.
